Thanks for working on this 💯 

I think the change in positional agreement is a breaking change once addressed I think we can merge this 🙏

✅ Thanks @pcbeingused333 for the quick fixes!

👀 @WilliamBergamin could you take another look? We need your approval before we can merge this.

review_comments.body: praise: Nice catch on the async factory drifting from the sync one! Matching the default and position keeps the two signatures easy to compare 🙌

🚦 suggestion (blocking): Could this go after `logger` instead? Placing it before `client` and `logger` shifts their positions for anyone passing them positionally, while appending keeps it a pure addition.

```suggestion
        client: Optional[AsyncWebClient] = None,
        logger: Optional[Logger] = None,
        token_rotation_expiration_minutes: int = 120,
```

🧪 suggestion (non-blocking): Could we also assert on `settings.authorize`? That's the value the app actually uses to refresh tokens.

```suggestion
        assert oauth_flow.settings.token_rotation_expiration_minutes == 30
        assert oauth_flow.settings.authorize.token_rotation_expiration_minutes == 30
```
